attr.title: Audiofilus
attr.desc: A pixel-art music player that keeps playing while you game. Send it to the background and control it with hotkeys, or turn the screen off and control it from your pocket. Plays your library, internet radio, podcasts and Subsonic/Jellyfin servers.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Put your music (MP3, AAC/M4A, ALAC, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, WAV, AIFF, MOD/XM/IT) in a folder and pick it on the first run.
